zh:
建议操作
证书或 npm 异常：点击「修复证书与 npm」。
文件选择无返回：到插件页使用「其他文件选择器」。
第三方插件导致启动失败：使用启动页的安全启动，再逐个恢复插件。
存储不足：清理下载目录后重试，避免重新解压整个环境。

隐私范围：未读取 API 配置、对话、终端命令或系统完整日志；没有自动上传此报告。可在下面补充复现步骤后复制或导出。
en:
Suggested actions
Certificate or npm errors: select “Repair certificates and npm”.
File picker returns nothing: use “Other file picker” on the Plugins page.
A third-party plugin prevents startup: use Safe startup, then restore plugins one at a time.
Low storage: clear the downloads directory and retry; avoid extracting the entire environment again.

Privacy scope: this report did not read API settings, conversations, terminal commands, or complete system logs, and was not uploaded automatically. Add reproduction steps below before copying or exporting it.
